final: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type COLLATE BINARY = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type COLLATE BINARY = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS account_average FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), frequency_averages AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(account_average) AS frequency_average FROM account_averages GROUP BY frequency) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.frequency, aa.account_average, aa.account_average / fa.frequency_average AS quotient FROM account_averages AS aa JOIN frequency_averages AS fa ON aa.frequency COLLATE BINARY = fa.frequency COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY quotient DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
